# The Craft Box Porthcawl

> A creative hub in Porthcawl, South Wales, showcasing handmade crafts and
> original artwork from local resident artists.

The Craft Box is a cosy creative space in Porthcawl — "an arts and craft
fair in a box" — founded by Amanda in November 2025. It's home to resident
artists and makers working in seaglass, ceramics, painting, jewellery and
more, selling handmade gifts and original artwork under one roof.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thecraftboxporthcawl.co.uk/): what The Craft Box is and how to get involved.
- [Meet the Artists](https://thecraftboxporthcawl.co.uk/meet-the-artists): the resident artists and makers, their studios and their work.
- [Events](https://thecraftboxporthcawl.co.uk/events): upcoming events, workshops and markets.
- [About Us](https://thecraftboxporthcawl.co.uk/about-us): the story of how The Craft Box started and its mission.

## Key facts

- Physical shop in Porthcawl, South Wales, alongside The Pantri box in the Hillsboro car park.
- Home to resident artists working across seaglass, ceramics, painting, jewellery, candles and more.
- Contact: craftboxporthcawl@gmail.com
- Social: Facebook and Instagram @craftboxporthcawl
